text: The cheese ripens and is sold under brine, so it never forms a rind and ends up salty and white. Salting swaps calcium for sodium in the casein, which improves its consistency.

steps.note: The cheese is salted dry; the finished cheese ends at 3.5–7 % salt.
The cheese is ripened in a brine of about 7 % salt, for weeks at room temperature.
